Results.Title: Seems like well built grill

Results.ReviewText: Very good product cook things just right very easy to use
Results.Title: Great product

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Replaced a 15 year-old 2 burner Weber Spirit grill.  Really like the third burner and sear zone, along with the cast iron grates.  Enameled side tables a major upgrade over the previous stainless steel versions. Drip pan now has a roof to prevent solid drippings from clogging the opening. Still seems to be very well built and was easy to assemble.
Results.Title: Third Weber gas grill over the past thirty years.

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber grill.  The first one lasted 15 + years and was still working.  It needed a lighter to ignite it, however it basically rusted through.  When I went to move it the bottom fell through.  In addition to the superb cooking ability what I like most is the warranty. On my first Weber after about 6 or 7 years the burners were defective and Weber sent me a new complete set of burners, igniter, etc. It was like a total new grill. Well worth it. Thanks Weber.
Results.Title: Weber is the best.

Results.ReviewText:
My first Weber lasted over 10 yrs it was a Spirit 310 with side burner I just purchased a Spirit E325
A little disappointed in some of the features that this one didn't have that my first one did have I didn't get to see it as I had to order it online it's a smaller cook surface which is ok but it no longer has 4 wheels and its too heavy for me with just 2 
No lo ger has the hanging thing to tell u how much propane is left and also it isn't enclosed In the back
Results.Title: 2nd Weber

Results.ReviewText: While it’s smaller than my last grill it can still get enough food for a family of 6. Starts up easily and is consistent with heat all around. I’d buy again.
Results.Title: Good For Family of 6

Results.ReviewText: My Weber E-325 is a great replacement for the E-315. It is easy to operate does a great job and is compact enough to move around the patio with ease. Weber is  long lasting and dependable grill.

Results.ReviewText: Once I got it assembled, it is a great little grill. I especially like the large wheels, and the 3 separate ignition systems. It did come with 2 right side panels, and no left side. It took about 2 weeks to get the correct one delivered. The online help was not good, but the live person took care of it immediately.
Results.Title: Well built small grill

Results.ReviewText: Quality grill for the price I feel like this grill will last a long time.
Results.Title: Enjoying my new weber. No flair ups and even heat.

Results.ReviewText: I've had a Weber gas grill for over 20 years and decided to upgrade (????) - nothing wrong with the old one (just old - gave it to my son). Bought it from a local hardware store and decided to put it together myself (84yo). It seemed to be packed ok but when I took the pieces out of the box, the side pieces were bent and wouldn't fit together - I had to try and reshape the crushed parts with a hammer. I finally (after some struggle) got the parts to align and put the grill together. Even though the grill looked kind of misaligned when put together, I was not going to go through the hassle of taking it apart, packing it up and returning it. It started up ok and after a bit of a learning curve regarding the temperature control (read the instructions carefully), seems to be operating fine. For me, Weber is still grill of choice and works as advertised.
Results.Title: Weber Spirit E325 Assembly and Operation

Results.ReviewText: The fact that you can get the grill super hot allows you to quickly cook fish filets (1.5 - 2 minutes per side) without drying them out. A game changer.
Results.Title: Love the sear function

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We appreciate you choosing Weber and understand that transitioning from a Genesis grill you've enjoyed for over 20 years can come with some noticeable differences. We value your comments regarding the construction and temperature control, as they help us continue improving our products. We're glad to hear you're achieving satisfying grilling  results and hope that, as you become more familiar with your new Spirit E-325, it continues to meet your expectations. Thank you again for sharing your experience with us, and we wish you many enjoyable cooks ahead.

Results.ReviewText: This grill will probably be fine in the long run; however, I notice that the construction seems flimsier than my previous 20+ year old Genesis grill. As an example, the lid is made of very thin metal as opposed to the solid steel/iron in my old grill. I'm struggling with temperature control on the new grill as the grill runs hotter with all three burners in the low setting than my old grill. I'll probably get used to all of this and learn how to make this grill work well for me, but my initial impression is that I'm not as wowed as I thought I would be. It otherwise seems fine, and I am using it to grill meats with satisfactory results.
Results.Title: This grill is OK, but I'm not wowed so far

Results.ReviewText: I paid a premium price for a new weber grill, following reviews by relatives who purchased one. This was not a premium experience. The grill was delivered assembled by ACE hardware, but was missing the entire grease trap assembly so they had to come back out for that. Hooked up current tank used with previous grill and loud gas leak from hose/regulator. Contacted customer support they insisted was an issue with the tank and not the hose. Bought a $25 hose from home depot - no lead with same tank. They refused to accept the hose was faulty and send me another. I would not buy Weber again for the premium you pay.
Results.Title: Premium price for a less that stellar experience

Results.ReviewText: Bought my E-325 two years ago, and only assembled this pass year. Upon opening package, discovered door had a dent at bottom which made it impossible to install as hole for the hinge was misshapen and would not work. Weber being the great company they are, was at first not going to replace the door, but after I spoke to the wonderful, agent, and sent photos, they agreed that I was deserving of a door and sent one to me! I showed photos that I was actually assembling the product. So again thank you Weber, you have a fan for life. This is my second Weber as I was/ still am using my older model.
Results.Title: Weber, is there any other brand out there?

Results.ReviewText: For the money you pay for this grill you won't find a better value! The amount of options available and the things you can do with this grill is amazing! As always the quality is unmatched. I would recommend this grill to anyone who asks!
Results.Title: Versatility
